reason: A is the better proposal because it extends prior dual-phase and extreme-deformation findings to test whether deformation-induced defects create embrittling features in an initially single-phase alloy, whereas B largely repeats the cited study’s Cr-rich-precipitate segregation-engineering experiment. A remains weakened by conflating several competing mechanisms and by treating amorphization as brittle despite cited evidence that it can dissipate energy, so the experiment should separate phase transformation from grain-boundary segregation.
